name: Stone of Relu
summary: In the Wetlands, Stone of Relu is lost after raptors ambush Archaeologist Flagongut. He believes it can unlock secrets within ancient fossils.

sections.title: A Key to Ancient Relics
sections.body: The Explorers' League uncovered Stone of Relu. Archaeologist Flagongut believes the artifact can decipher prehistoric fossils gathered from Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. He plans to study his Wetlands specimens and the fossil Prospector Remtravel unearthed in Darkshore.

sections.title: Lost in the Marshes
sections.body: On a Wetlands road, Archaeologist Flagongut was traveling to meet Prospector Whelgar when mottled raptors ambushed him. In the scramble, the relic was lost, then swallowed by one of the beasts. Now the League seeks the marsh raptors, hoping to cut the ancient stone from their gullets.

faq.q: What is the Stone of Relu?
faq.answer: Archaeologist Flagongut seeks Stone of Relu, an ancient artifact he believes can unlock the hidden mysteries and power within prehistoric fossils.

faq.q: How did the stone end up inside a raptor?
faq.answer: Mottled raptors attacked Archaeologist Flagongut on a Wetlands road as he traveled to meet Prospector Whelgar. In the chaos, one beast swallowed the lost stone.

faq.q: What is Flagongut planning to do with the stone?
faq.answer: Flagongut plans to use Stone of Relu on his recovered fossil and the fossil Prospector Remtravel found in Darkshore. He hopes to decipher and release their latent magical secrets.

angles.text: For the Explorers' League, Stone of Relu may help piece together the origins of ancient life and the world's forgotten legacy.
Alliance expeditions in Menethil Harbor rely on recovered artifacts like Stone of Relu to justify difficult excavations across the perilous marshlands.
